context_data.description: 修复 calc.py 中 add 函数的 bug

understanding.summary: Fix a bug in the 'add' function within calc.py file
understanding.approach: 1. Locate the calc.py file in the repository. 2. Find the 'add' function definition. 3. Analyze the current implementation to identify the bug (common issues: incorrect operator, wrong return value, type handling errors, off-by-one errors). 4. Fix the identified bug and verify the correction.
